cdWindowDim - Template Registration

When you run the installer, it can automatically register the template during installation.

If you decide not to allow that, or if you need to re-register the template later, follow these steps:

  1. In the Clarion IDE, click Tools > Edit Template Registry.
  2. In the Template Registry window, click Register.
  3. In the file picker, navigate to: C:\ClarionXX\accessory\template\win\
  4. Select CDWindowDim.tpl and click Open.
  5. Confirm that cdWindowDim appears in the list of registered templates and click OK.

If you install or upgrade to a new version of Clarion, you may need to register cdWindowDim in that version.

Next, read Using the Template in Your Application.
